It is a divine cow, who is considered the giver of all pleasures and the embodiment of prosperity. According to Hindu mythology, she is the mother of all cows and the one who nourishes the gods and the universe. Surabhi's name is also associated with the fragrant flowers of the Kadamb tree, symbolizing purity, abundance, and prosperity.

vedic_reference.note: The name Surabhi is mentioned in the Rigveda and Mahabharata. Surabhi is a divine cow, the mother of all cows, and the source of all milk and sustenance for the gods. She is described as having a thousand teats and is considered to be the embodiment of prosperity and abundance.
